weather.tip: 88% chance of rain most of the day — carry an umbrella and budget extra commute time; today's Cauvery-related bandh could also cause pockets of disruption even though several groups have opted out.

around.headline: Karnataka bandh today over the Cauvery water-sharing row
around.summary: Vatal Nagaraj's call for a statewide bandh on August 13 is likely to have limited impact after several Kannada organisations withdrew support, but schools, banks and hospitals are officially staying open and the airport has issued a travel advisory. Check with your workplace or school before heading out, and keep buffer time in case specific routes see disruption.
around.source: The Times of India, Hindustan Times

around.headline: Woman falls into a broken stretch of road and is fatally run over
around.summary: A mother of a 3-year-old died after a fall linked to a damaged, unbarricaded road, and residents are now demanding answers from the municipal council. If you spot a similar hazard near you, report it with a photo and exact location to BBMP's helpline (1533) or the Sahaaya app rather than assuming it'll get noticed on its own.

around.headline: Ola, Uber and Rapido issued notices for overcharging
around.summary: Authorities have sent notices to the three ride-hailing platforms over overcharging complaints. Keep a screenshot of the quoted fare versus what you're actually charged — it's your evidence if you need to dispute a ride or file a complaint on the National Consumer Helpline (1915).

around.headline: Food safety raids reach Vidhana Soudha and health department canteens
around.summary: FDA inspectors found violations at the Arogya Soudha canteen and other government kitchens, days after sealing a Zomato Hyperpure warehouse and finding fungus and questionable meat at top eateries. Worth checking FSSAI hygiene ratings on delivery apps before ordering over the next few days.

around.headline: Drivers' protest disrupts electric AC bus services
around.summary: A protest by drivers at a depot has disrupted BMTC's electric AC bus services across parts of the city. If your commute depends on these routes, check for a KSRTC/BMTC alternate route or app-based update before you leave.

around.headline: CAG flags Rs 6,600 crore Metro cost overrun; suburban rail only 20% complete
around.summary: A CAG report says Namma Metro's Phase 1 and 2 ran Rs 6,600 crore over budget with ridership below projections, while the long-awaited suburban rail project is only 20% physically complete and will use a new European signalling system. Don't expect either to meaningfully ease your commute in the near term — plan around current metro/bus options.

around.headline: Mumbai landslip death toll confirmed as bodies are recovered
around.summary: Rescue teams recovered and identified the bodies of seven people killed when a landslip hit Mumbai during heavy monsoon rain. With Bengaluru itself forecast an 88% chance of rain today, treat any waterlogged ground near construction sites, slopes or retaining walls with the same caution — don't linger or shelter close to them.

street_smart.title: You spot a stretch of broken, unbarricaded road near your home — right where a woman fell and was fatally run over today. What do you do?
street_smart.based_on: Real incident today: a mother of a 3-year-old died after a fall linked to a damaged road, with residents demanding answers from the municipal council (The Times of India).
street_smart.situation: Walking home, you notice a bad pothole and a collapsed stretch of road with no barricade or warning sign — the same kind of hazard that killed someone nearby just today. It's dusk, and it's about to rain. What do you do?

choices.text: Take a photo, post it on social media tagging BBMP, and move on.
choices.feedback: Risky. A public post can raise awareness, but it doesn't create an official complaint with a tracking number, so there's no guarantee anyone with the authority to fix it ever sees it or is held to a timeline.

choices.text: Walk around it carefully yourself and assume the civic body will notice and fix it, since it already caused a death.
choices.feedback: This is the trap. Civic bodies act on logged complaints, not on the assumption that someone else will report it — 'it's already fatal, so surely they'll fix it' is exactly the thinking that lets the same hazard injure the next person.

choices.text: File a complaint with a photo and the exact location on BBMP's Sahaaya app or the helpline (1533); if it's on a busy road or near a bus stop, also flag it to traffic police control (112).
choices.feedback: Correct. A geotagged photo complaint through the official channel creates a trackable ticket, and looping in traffic police for high-traffic spots adds pressure for a temporary barricade or warning sign while the repair is pending.

choices.text: Get neighbours together to block the road in protest until someone from BBMP shows up.
choices.feedback: Also a trap. Blocking a road at dusk, in the rain, near a hazard that already killed someone creates a second dangerous situation and doesn't guarantee faster action — a documented complaint plus follow-up calls gets further, faster.

takeaways: BBMP's Sahaaya app or helpline (1533) is the direct channel for road-hazard complaints — a photo and exact location get it logged as a trackable ticket.
For hazards that have already caused injury or death, a police complaint alongside the civic one adds legal pressure and a record separate from the repair request.
Don't rely on social media alone or physically block traffic — neither creates the accountability trail an official complaint does.

quiz.question: What dispute is behind today's Karnataka bandh call?
options: The Cauvery water-sharing row with Tamil Nadu
quiz.why: The bandh, called by Vatal Nagaraj, saw several Kannada organisations withdraw support beforehand, which is why its impact on the city was expected to be limited despite the call going out.

quiz.question: Besides the Arogya Soudha canteen, where else did today's FDA hygiene raid find violations?
quiz.why: Arogya Soudha houses Karnataka's health department headquarters, which made the hygiene violations found there especially notable.

quiz.question: Which three ride-hailing platforms were issued notices today over overcharging complaints?
quiz.why: Fare-overcharging complaints against app-based cab and bike-taxi operators have been a recurring regulatory flashpoint in Bengaluru this year.

quiz.question: The Cauvery river, at the centre of today's water-sharing dispute, originates in which state?
quiz.why: The river rises at Talakaveri in Karnataka's Kodagu (Coorg) district before flowing through both Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, which is the root of the decades-old sharing dispute.

quiz.question: What does the acronym FSSAI stand for?
options: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
Federal Standards and Safety Authority of India
Food Security and Supply Authority of India
Food Sanitation and Safety Association of India
quiz.why: FSSAI sets and enforces food safety standards nationwide, and its hygiene rating stickers/app can be checked before ordering from a restaurant or dark store.
